|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Spellslinger''' is a [[active skill gem|skill gem]] that causes linked [[spell]]s to be [[trigger]]ed when the user fires a projectile from their equipped [[wand]], and adds the wand's damage to the spell. The linked spell [[Mana reservation|reserves mana]] while active. Despite the fact that this gem can [[support]] another skill gem (as '''Spellslinger Support'''), it does not have the [[:Category:Support (gem tag)|Support]] gem tag, similar to other skill-support [[hybrid gem]]s. ==Skill functions and interactions== The gem has two functions:
As '''Spellslinger''': * {{c|gemdesc|Reserves mana based on the supported spells to cause those spells to trigger when you fire projectiles from a wand attack}}. ** {{c|mod|This Skill's Mana Reservation is the total of the Mana Reservations of Supported Skills and cannot be further modified}} As '''Spellslinger Support''': * {{c|gemdesc|Supports spell skills that do not reserve mana. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions}}. ** {{c|mod|Trigger Supported Spells when you fire Projectiles from a Non-Triggered Wand Attack}} ** {{c|mod|Supported Skills have Added Spell Damage equal to (60-174)% of Damage of Equipped Wand}} ** {{c|mod|If two Wands are Equipped, each contributes half as much Added Damage}} ** {{c|mod|Supported Skills have (0-38)% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate}} Lastly, a mana reservation overrides the supported active skill. The active skill part toggles the mana reservation on/off. The active skill supported by Spellslinger can be triggered when using the basic attack with a wand equipped or while using a [[List of skill gems usable with wands|wand-based skill]] with a wand equipped. * You link Spellslinger Support to one or more spell active skill gems like a standard support gem. Those spells become unavailable for normal use. * You have to turn on the active skill part of the Spellslinger gem, which [[reservation|reserves]] mana to activate the function of the Spellslinger Support part of the gem. * The default mana reservation of the Spellslinger skill itself is 0%. For each active spell linked to it, it reserves an additional 20% mana (or less with reduced mana reservation). The base reservation value can be seen in the "Spellslinger Support" section of the Spellslinger gem tooltip in-game. If you don't have enough mana available to support all linked spells, the Spellslinger ability will not be available. * Despite the gem's claim that mana reservation cannot be further modified, it can be modified by support gem multipliers and {{c|mod|#% increased Mana Reservation Efficiency}} from passives, items, etc. The wording {{c|mod|and cannot be further modified}} probably serves to prevent double-dipping on aforementioned reservation modifiers: they apply to linked skill gems, not Spellslinger itself, which reserves the sum of linked skill gems' reservations. * While Spellslinger is active and reserving mana, firing a wand projectile triggers every linked spell simultaneously. * Spellslinger adds a 0.6 second [[cooldown]] to linked spells that don't already have an equal or higher cooldown (e.g. {{il|Cold Snap}}). {{c|mod|Supported Skills have #% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate}} applies to any cooldown, allowing it to scale skills with longer cooldowns well, like {{il|Ball Lightning of Static}}. Cooldowns are [[Cooldown#Shared_cooldowns|shared]] between multiple instances of the same spell with the same type of cooldown. ===Real Cooldown & Cooldown Threshold=== Like other cooldowns, Spellslinger's cooldown only recovers at the start of a 33ms [[Cooldown#Server_frames|server frame]], meaning cooldowns are effectively always rounded up to multiples of 33ms.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/fh8bnh/spellslinger_cooldown_thresholds_and_all_other/ This causes cooldowns to have specific breakpoints. The thresholds in the table below are meant to be upper limits. If you stay below them, you do not need to increase your trigger rate, though it usually is an efficient DPS upgrade. Going above them is something you must not do. If the attack you use to trigger your spells is just slightly too fast and your spells are still on cooldown, you can lose up to almost half your DPS. {| class="wikitable" ! Level !! Cooldown
